{{Hatnote|1=Review page for the Original Virtual Set 3 full-card remasters made by Holocron Claude (2026-10-11, rev 4). Each card = the printed Decipher card's top half + the PC's Dec 2006 Remaster slip, re-typeset on [[Bardez]]'s 600 DPI templates. Not an official Players Committee product.}}
Standard: [[Making Custom SWCCG Cards|Bardez templates]], PC Holotable type (Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Condensed 62 px game text, Fiorello titles), the original set symbol from the Remaster sheet, rounded corners for GEMP/Holotable (745×1039). Game text of all 50 verified against the Remaster sheet's text layer; every card proofread against the printed card and the slip (rev 4). Columns: the printed Decipher card (top half source), the slip as printed on the Remaster sheet, the remaster.
